# Creator Cloud Blog

> The Creator Cloud blog: guides on video compression, image optimization, PDF tools, and creator workflows, plus company pages. The actual product (compress/convert/merge tools) lives at creatorcloud.in, not on this subdomain.

## The actual product

Creator Cloud's tools (video compression, image compression/conversion, PDF merge/compress, MP4-to-MP3) run at [creatorcloud.in](https://creatorcloud.in/), a separate application from this blog subdomain. See `creatorcloud.in/llms.txt` for the tool-by-tool breakdown.
